notes.title: Passtech Games Community Discord!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5979014/508293995602b4023ac6bbd66d28a1c527314b0b.png[/img]

Hi there, Space Runners!

We're glad that some of you are still enjoying[i] Space Run[/i] and [i]Space Run: Galaxy[/i]! We have opened a Discord server where all players from our community can join and discuss with the team and each other.

[h1][b]Join us right here: [url=https://discord.gg/qFrSrV4]https://discord.gg/qFrSrV4[/url][/b][/h1]

We're also working on [i]Curse of the Dead Gods[/i], a rogue-lite action game published by Focus Home Interactive that is currently under development and playable in Alpha state. If you are interested, you can join the Alpha right here:

https://curse-of-the-dead-gods.com/first-explorer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5979014/301234a8b7e1121a091e68decbb44c0699c52d6b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Watch Space Run Galaxy Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/24/1466158930-srg-gif-3.gif[/img]

[b]Space Run Galaxy is available today on Steam![/b]

Our previous Gameplay Trailer showed you the ropes of space running, today we let you move on to practice with our Launch Trailer. [b]Strap on your seatbelt, recharge your shields and warm up your reactors, it’s going to be a bumpy intergalactic ride! [/b]

Set 20 years after the original game, Captain Buck Mann has now set up his very own intergalactic courier service. You’re a member of Mann’s team of space runners, racing to deliver precious goods from planet to planet! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2S5s7wAzhjA
Reinforce your modular ships with armaments including laser turrets, missile launchers and energy shields, while leaving enough room for your cargo. Fly fast – the quicker you arrive at your destination, the better the rewards!

In Space Run Galaxy, you must defend your ship and its cargo as it travels the stars to deliver goods to your clients across an entire galaxy. 

With four solar systems and over 50 zones to visit across 100+ runs, Space Run Galaxy offers limitless gameplay, while fresh new features expand the original experience:
[list][*]User-created contracts - Take on contracts from other players for better rewards and unlimited replayability
[*]Intergalactic player market - Trade hard-earned goods with your fellow space runners to sell off extra supplies, or snap up a tidy bargain
[*]New corporations offer riskier jobs - Carry the extra fragile cargo of XenoPrime, or risk transporting The Force's highly dangerous weapon prototypes (which may even endanger your own ship!) 
[*]Fresh dangers await - Face off against brand new boss-type enemies, such as deadly pirate ships and huge space monsters...
[*]Deep customization - Customize the shape, size, and color of any ships you acquire during your adventure. There's no restriction for what ship you use in each mission, letting you get creative with every run![/list]

[b]Space Run Galaxy is available today on Steam for PC.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/355800

notes.title: Pre-order now at 15% off!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/23/1465316124-news-preorder.png[/img]

[b]You can now pre-order Space Run Galaxy for 15% off on Steam![/b] 

Preorder players will also receive exclusive content, including: the original soundtrack (MP3 format), 4 exclusive in-game badges, and access to the Beta starting one week before game's release. 

Defend your ship and cargo as you travel the stars to deliver goods to clients across an entire galaxy, with four planetary systems and over 50 zones to visit. The entire 1st solar system will be at your disposal during the Beta. 

Reinforce your modular ships with armaments including laser turrets, missile launchers and energy shields, while leaving enough room for your cargo. Fly fast - the quicker you arrive at your destination, the better the rewards! 

Space Run Galaxy offers limitless gameplay, with fresh new features expanding the original experience: 
[list]
[*][b]User-created contracts[/b] - Take on contracts from other players for better rewards and unlimited replayability
[*][b]Intergalactic player market[/b] - Trade hard-earned goods with your fellow space runners to sell off extra supplies, or snap up a tidy bargain
[*][b]New corporations offer riskier jobs[/b] - Carry the extra fragile cargo of XenoPrime, or risk transporting The Force's highly dangerous weapon prototypes (which may even endanger your own ship!) 
[*][b]Fresh dangers await[/b] - Face off against brand new boss-type enemies, such as deadly pirate ships and huge space monsters...
[*][b]Deep customization[/b] - Customize the shape, size, and color of any ships you acquire during your adventure. There's no restriction for what ship you use in each mission, letting you get creative with every run!
[/list]

Space Run Galaxy releases on June 17th for PC. For more information, visit the website [b][url=http://www.spacerun-galaxy.com/]here![/url][/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/355800
